name: Brewing Results: Good Effects

results.text: You are hasted for 1 minute (as the haste spell, no concentration): your speed is doubled, you gain +2 AC and advantage on Dexterity saves, and you get one extra action each turn (Attack with one weapon attack only, Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object). When it ends, you can't move or take actions until after your next turn.
